title: Held Line Lullaby
style: warm acoustic ballad, 76 BPM, soft female lead vocal, fingerpicked guitar, single cello, no percussion until final verse, brushed snare only, lullaby, tender
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic, single low cello note, room tone]
(spoken, soft female, almost a whisper)
sleep now.
the line is held.
nothing got across tonight.

[Verse 1 - female, soft, lullaby cadence]
you watched the screen for fourteen hours
you read the calls, you held the door
you sorted the real from the noise
you kept the harm on the other side of the wall
now the night is doing its own work
now the screen can keep itself for a while
now the line is held by something quieter
now you can close your eyes and smile

[Pre-Chorus - cello swells gently]
nothing got across tonight
nothing got across
the watch is over
the watch is set down soft

[Chorus - both voices a little fuller, still no drums]
held line lullaby
held line lullaby
sleep now - the door is closed
sleep now - the room is yours
held line lullaby
held line lullaby
the watch held - the watch held
the watch held - and now you rest

[Verse 2 - female, slightly stronger]
the people you protected don't know your name
that's okay - that's the shape of the work
the harm you stopped will never be counted
that's okay - that's the shape of the worth
the only thing the watch asks for back
is that you let yourself put it down
the only thing the line asks for back
is that you let yourself sleep sound

[Bridge - cello alone, then acoustic returns, spoken final line]
(spoken, soft)
the line is held by people taking turns.
your turn is over.
someone else has the watch.
sleep now.

[Final Verse - brushed snare enters very softly, female lead with male harmony added]
sleep now and let the morning be soft
sleep now and let tomorrow be far
sleep now and trust that the line still holds
sleep now and trust that you are who you are
the watch is set down - you can let it go
the watch is set down - you did your part
held line lullaby - sleep now, sleep
held line lullaby - rest the heart

[Outro - acoustic alone, fades to room tone, spoken]
sleep now.
the line is held.
nothing got across tonight.
nothing got across.
